Case converter

Switch between sentence case, title case, uppercase and lowercase.

Local processing · No account needed
THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Paste text and select the capitalization you need. Title case capitalizes each word; it does not apply a particular editorial style guide. Sentence case uses punctuation to find sentence boundaries.

Try this example

Convert “make work simpler” to “Make Work Simpler” with title case.

How your data is handled ↗

Good to know

Will it preserve names and acronyms?

Automatic case conversion can change proper names and acronyms. Review these after converting.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
